articles.title: ‘You have 10 minutes to decide’: answering the life-changing call to become a kinship carer
articles.description:
Those who have stepped in to keep young family members from going into care in England and Wales say the decision has brought them joy and hardship

Clive vividly remembers the day when, without warning or time to work out what he was really letting himself in for, he became a kinship carer.

“The social worker left, the door closed and Savannah was lying there in a carry cot, wrapped up in a pink blanket. She looked so calm and so comfy, absolutely oblivious about what’s just happened.

articles.title: Two Iranian men identified Manchester synagogue as site for alleged bomb plot, court hears
articles.description:
Rahman Salehi, 34, and Salam Ahmadyan, 36, were charged with preparing attacks on city’s Jewish community, including Heaton Park synagogue

Two Iranian men identified a Manchester synagogue previously subjected to a fatal terrorist attack as a target for an alleged homemade bomb plot, a court has heard.

Rahman Salehi, 34, from Salford, and Salam Ahmadyan, 36, from Liverpool were charged with preparing to commit an act of terrorism or assisting another to commit an act of terrorism on Friday.

articles.title: Two Iranian men charged over alleged terror plot targeting Manchester’s Jewish community
articles.description:
Man, most likely in Iran, was in contact with men arrested on the eve of Yom Kippur, police say

Two Iranian men have been charged in relation to an alleged terror plot targeting Manchester’s Jewish community.

​Police say another man, most likely in Iran, was in contact with them as part of a plot to get a bomb to attack Jewish targets.
